grid_contract.center: centroid of the exact-time initial FEDS perimeter, projected to local UTM
grid_contract.rasterization: whole initial perimeter as historical scar; exact-time FEDS active line as active cells; all_touched=true

limitations: FEDS perimeter and active line are satellite-derived estimates, not ground truth.
This only checks source geometry coverage and fixed-map extent; it does not test fire spread or suppression.
The active FEDS line is an observed satellite-estimated front, not a crew-built suppression line.
